// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/ MPL-2.0
//@version=6
indicator("HUNTER OCI ALL SESSION", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500)


// ========================================================================= //
// ==== TIME FRAME CHECK =================================================== //
// ========================================================================= //
if timeframe.isdaily or timeframe.isweekly or timeframe.ismonthly
    runtime.error("هذا السكربت مخصص للفريمات اللحظية ولا يعمل على الفريم اليومي أو الأكبر/This script is designed for intraday timeframes and does not work on the daily timeframe or higher.")

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== INPUTS ============================================================= //
// ========================================================================= //
showOpeningZone = input.bool(true, title="إظهار تظليل افتتاح الجلسة", group="Session & Range")
zoneColor       = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 85), title="لون التظليل", group="Session & Range")

lineHighColor   = input.color(color.red, "لون خط القمة", group="Lines & Visuals")
lineHighWidth   = input.int(2, "سمك خط القمة", group="Lines & Visuals")
lineLowColor    = input.color(color.green, "لون خط القاع", group="Lines & Visuals")
lineLowWidth    = input.int(2, "سمك خط القاع", group="Lines & Visuals")

targetLineStyleInput = input.string("Dashed", "نمط خطوط الأهداف", options=["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group="Lines & Visuals")
targetLineWidth = input.int(1, "سمك خطوط الأهداف", group="Lines & Visuals")
targetLblSize   = input.string("normal", "حجم خط الأهداف", options=["tiny", "small", "normal", "large", "huge"], group="Lines & Visuals")

targetHitColor  = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 80), "لون منطقة الهدف بعد التحقيق", group="Lines & Visuals")

radar_len       = input.int(11, "طول رادار 1", minval=1, group="Radar & Momentum")
radar_len11     = input.int(33, "طول رادار 2", minval=1, group="Radar & Momentum")
showRadarBounds = input.bool(true, "إظهار حدود سحابة الرادار كخطوط", group="Radar & Momentum")

radarUpColor1   = input.color(color.new(color.green, 90), "تدرج سحابة الرادار الصاعدة (أضعف)", group="Radar & Momentum")
radarUpColor2   = input.color(color.new(color.green, 60), "تدرج سحابة الرادار الصاعدة (أقوى)", group="Radar & Momentum")
radarDnColor1   = input.color(color.new(color.red, 60), "تدرج سحابة الرادار الهابطة (أقوى)", group="Radar & Momentum")
radarDnColor2   = input.color(color.new(color.red, 90), "تدرج سحابة الرادار الهابطة (أضعف)", group="Radar & Momentum")

font_size       = input.string("small", "حجم الخط في الجدول", options=["tiny", "small", "normal", "large", "huge"], group="Tables")
sigTablePosInput= input.string("top_right", "مكان جدول الإشارات", options=["bottom_right","bottom_left","top_right","top_left"], group="Tables")

lineStyle = targetLineStyleInput == "Solid" ? line.style_solid : targetLineStyleInput == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_dashed
lblSize   = targetLblSize == "tiny" ? size.tiny : targetLblSize == "small" ? size.small : targetLblSize == "normal" ? size.normal : targetLblSize == "large" ? size.large : size.huge

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== RADAR ============================================================== //
// ========================================================================= //
radar_isBull = close > open
radar_midPrice = radar_isBull ? (open + close) / 2 : na
radar_midEMA   = ta.ema(radar_midPrice, radar_len)

radar_midPrice11 = radar_isBull ? (open + close) / 2 : na
radar_midEMA11   = ta.ema(radar_midPrice11, radar_len11)

greenLine = ta.sma(radar_midEMA, 3)
redLine   = ta.sma(radar_midEMA11, 3)

upperRadar = math.max(greenLine, redLine)
lowerRadar = math.min(greenLine, redLine)

momentum = ta.roc(close, 10)

color radar_cloud_color = na
if greenLine > redLine
    radar_cloud_color := color.from_gradient(momentum, 0, 5, radarUpColor1, radarUpColor2)
else
    radar_cloud_color := color.from_gradient(momentum, -5, 0, radarDnColor1, radarDnColor2)

p_green = plot(greenLine, color=showRadarBounds ? color.new(color.green, 0) : na)
p_red   = plot(redLine, color=showRadarBounds ? color.new(color.red, 0) : na)
fill(p_green, p_red, color=radar_cloud_color)

barColor = close > upperRadar ? color.green : close < lowerRadar ? color.red : color.yellow
barcolor(barColor)

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== OPENING RANGE ====================================================== //
// ========================================================================= //
bool sessionFirstBar = time("D") != nz(time("D")[1])
var float openHigh = na
var float openLow  = na
var float openRange = na

if sessionFirstBar or na(openHigh)
    openHigh := high
    openLow  := low
    openRange := high - low

bool inOpeningRange = close <= openHigh and close >= openLow

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== TARGETS ============================================================ //
// ========================================================================= //
var array<float> upTargets   = array.new<float>()
var array<float> downTargets = array.new<float>()
var array<line>  upLines     = array.new<line>()
var array<line>  downLines   = array.new<line>()
var array<box>   upBoxes     = array.new<box>()
var array<box>   downBoxes   = array.new<box>()
var array<bool>  upHit       = array.new<bool>()
var array<bool>  downHit     = array.new<bool>()
var array<label> targetLbls  = array.new<label>()

var line highLine = na
var line lowLine  = na
var label highLbl = na
var label lowLbl  = na
var box openZoneBox = na
var array<label> signalLabels = array.new<label>()

method addTarget(bool isUp, int index) =>
    float targetPrice = na
    float prevPrice = na
    
    if isUp
        prevPrice := index == 0 ? openHigh : upTargets.get(index - 1)
        targetPrice := prevPrice + (openRange * (index + 1))
        upTargets.push(targetPrice)
        upLines.push(line.new(bar_index, targetPrice, bar_index, targetPrice, color=color.new(color.green, 50), width=targetLineWidth, style=lineStyle))
        int trans = math.max(20, 90 - (index * 5))
        upBoxes.push(box.new(bar_index, prevPrice, bar_index, targetPrice, bgcolor=color.new(color.green, trans), border_color=na))
        upHit.push(false)
        targetLbls.push(label.new(bar_index, targetPrice, text="T" + str.tostring(index + 1) + ": " + str.tostring(targetPrice, format.mintick), color=color.new(color.green, 0), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=lblSize))
    else
        prevPrice := index == 0 ? openLow : downTargets.get(index - 1)
        targetPrice := prevPrice - (openRange * (index + 1))
        downTargets.push(targetPrice)
        downLines.push(line.new(bar_index, targetPrice, bar_index, targetPrice, color=color.new(color.red, 50), width=targetLineWidth, style=lineStyle))
        int trans = math.max(20, 90 - (index * 5))
        downBoxes.push(box.new(bar_index, prevPrice, bar_index, targetPrice, bgcolor=color.new(color.red, trans), border_color=na))
        downHit.push(false)
        targetLbls.push(label.new(bar_index, targetPrice, text="T" + str.tostring(index + 1) + ": " + str.tostring(targetPrice, format.mintick), color=color.new(color.red, 0), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=lblSize))

if sessionFirstBar
    if not na(highLine)
        highLine.delete()
    if not na(lowLine)
        lowLine.delete()
    if not na(highLbl)
        highLbl.delete()
    if not na(lowLbl)
        lowLbl.delete()
    if not na(openZoneBox)
        openZoneBox.delete()

    for l in upLines
        l.delete()
    for l in downLines
        l.delete()
    for b in upBoxes
        b.delete()
    for b in downBoxes
        b.delete()
    for lbl in targetLbls
        lbl.delete()
    for lbl in signalLabels
        lbl.delete()

    upLines.clear()
    downLines.clear()
    upBoxes.clear()
    downBoxes.clear()
    upTargets.clear()
    downTargets.clear()
    upHit.clear()
    downHit.clear()
    targetLbls.clear()
    signalLabels.clear()

    for i = 0 to 9
        addTarget(true, i)
        addTarget(false, i)

    highLine := line.new(bar_index, openHigh, bar_index, openHigh, color=lineHighColor, width=lineHighWidth)
    lowLine  := line.new(bar_index, openLow, bar_index, openLow, color=lineLowColor, width=lineLowWidth)
    highLbl  := label.new(bar_index, openHigh, text=str.tostring(openHigh, format.mintick), color=color.new(lineHighColor, 0), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=lblSize)
    lowLbl   := label.new(bar_index, openLow, text=str.tostring(openLow, format.mintick), color=color.new(lineLowColor, 0), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=lblSize)

    if showOpeningZone
        openZoneBox := box.new(bar_index, openHigh, bar_index, openLow, bgcolor=zoneColor, border_color=na)

// تقييم ضرب الأهداف
for i = 0 to upTargets.size() - 1
    if not upHit.get(i) and high >= upTargets.get(i)
        upHit.set(i, true)
        upBoxes.get(i).set_bgcolor(targetHitColor)

for i = 0 to downTargets.size() - 1
    if not downHit.get(i) and low <= downTargets.get(i)
        downHit.set(i, true)
        downBoxes.get(i).set_bgcolor(targetHitColor)

if upTargets.size() > 0 and high >= upTargets.get(upTargets.size() - 1)
    addTarget(true, upTargets.size())

if downTargets.size() > 0 and low <= downTargets.get(downTargets.size() - 1)
    addTarget(false, downTargets.size())

if bar_index > 0 and not na(openHigh)
    int targetX = bar_index + 10

    if not na(highLine)
        highLine.set_x2(targetX)
        highLbl.set_x(targetX)
    if not na(lowLine)
        lowLine.set_x2(targetX)
        lowLbl.set_x(targetX)
    if not na(openZoneBox)
        openZoneBox.set_right(targetX)

    int lblIdx = 0
    for i = 0 to upTargets.size() - 1
        upLines.get(i).set_x2(targetX)
        upBoxes.get(i).set_right(targetX)
        targetLbls.get(lblIdx).set_x(targetX)
        lblIdx += 1

    for i = 0 to downTargets.size() - 1
        downLines.get(i).set_x2(targetX)
        downBoxes.get(i).set_right(targetX)
        targetLbls.get(lblIdx).set_x(targetX)
        lblIdx += 1

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== SIGNALS (NEW LOGIC) =============================================== //
// ========================================================================= //

// 0 = لا إشارة
// 1 = شراء
// -1 = بيع
var int signalState = 0

var string actionText     = "WAIT"
var color  actionBg       = color.rgb(60,60,60)

if sessionFirstBar
    signalState := 0
    actionText  := "WAIT"
    actionBg    := color.rgb(60,60,60)
    for lbl in signalLabels
        lbl.delete()
    signalLabels.clear()

// حساب أجزاء الشمعة (فلتر شكل الشمعة)
float body      = math.abs(close - open)
float upperWick = high - math.max(close, open)
float lowerWick = math.min(close, open) - low
float totalWicks = upperWick + lowerWick

// كسر/اختراق الهاي واللو + وضع السعر بالنسبة للسحابة
bool breakLow    = close < openLow
bool breakHigh   = close > openHigh
bool belowCloud  = close < lowerRadar
bool aboveCloud  = close > upperRadar

// منطق تفعيل/قلب الإشارة
if barstate.isconfirmed
    // تفعيل أو تثبيت إشارة بيع (كسر اللو + تحت السحابة + شمعة قوية)
    if breakLow and belowCloud and body > totalWicks
        signalState := -1

    // تفعيل أو تثبيت إشارة شراء (اختراق الهاي + فوق السحابة + شمعة قوية)
    if breakHigh and aboveCloud and body > totalWicks
        signalState := 1

    // قلب الإشارة من بيع إلى شراء عند الإغلاق فوق السحابة
    if signalState == -1 and aboveCloud
        signalState := 1

    // قلب الإشارة من شراء إلى بيع عند الإغلاق تحت السحابة
    if signalState == 1 and belowCloud
        signalState := -1

// رسم الإشارات وتحديث النص
int prevState = nz(signalState[1])

if barstate.isconfirmed
    if signalState != prevState
        // مسح الإشارات السابقة
        for lbl in signalLabels
            lbl.delete()
        signalLabels.clear()

        if signalState == 1
            actionText := "BUY"
            actionBg   := color.green
            signalLabels.push(
                label.new(
                    bar_index, low,
                    text="▲",
                    color=color.new(color.green, 100),
                    textcolor=color.green,
                    style=label.style_label_up,
                    size=size.small
                )
            )
        else if signalState == -1
            actionText := "SELL"
            actionBg   := color.red
            signalLabels.push(
                label.new(
                    bar_index, high,
                    text="▼",
                    color=color.new(color.red, 100),
                    textcolor=color.red,
                    style=label.style_label_down,
                    size=size.small
                )
            )
        else
            actionText := "WAIT"
            actionBg   := color.rgb(60,60,60)

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== ACCELERATION ======================================================= //
// ========================================================================= //
accel_len = 7
speed = close - open
speed_prev = nz(close[accel_len]) - nz(open[accel_len])
accel = speed - speed_prev
norm_base = ta.sma(math.abs(speed), 7)
strength = norm_base != 0 ? accel / norm_base : 0.0

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== DYNAMIC SUPPORT & RESISTANCE (OPTION C) ============================ //
// ========================================================================= //

// --------- 1) أقرب أهداف فوق السعر (مقاومات) ---------
array<float> aboveTargets = array.new<float>()
for i = 0 to upTargets.size() - 1
    float t = upTargets.get(i)
    if t > close
        array.push(aboveTargets, t)
array.sort(aboveTargets, order.ascending)

float R1 = array.size(aboveTargets) >= 1 ? array.get(aboveTargets, 0) : na
float R2 = array.size(aboveTargets) >= 2 ? array.get(aboveTargets, 1) : na
float R3 = array.size(aboveTargets) >= 3 ? array.get(aboveTargets, 2) : na

// --------- 2) أقرب أهداف تحت السعر (دعوم) ---------
array<float> belowTargets = array.new<float>()
for i = 0 to downTargets.size() - 1
    float t = downTargets.get(i)
    if t < close
        array.push(belowTargets, t)
array.sort(belowTargets, order.descending)

float S1 = array.size(belowTargets) >= 1 ? array.get(belowTargets, 0) : na
float S2 = array.size(belowTargets) >= 2 ? array.get(belowTargets, 1) : na
float S3 = array.size(belowTargets) >= 3 ? array.get(belowTargets, 2) : na

// --------- 3) مستويات الرادار ---------
float radarSupport1 = lowerRadar
float radarSupport2 = na
float radarResistance1 = upperRadar
float radarResistance2 = na

if close > upperRadar
    radarSupport1 := upperRadar
    radarSupport2 := lowerRadar

if close < lowerRadar
    radarResistance1 := lowerRadar
    radarResistance2 := upperRadar

// --------- 4) دمج الافتتاح ---------
float openHighLevel = openHigh
float openLowLevel  = openLow

// --------- 5) المنطق الديناميكي (الخيار C) ---------
if actionText == "BUY"
    S1 := radarSupport1
    S2 := radarSupport2
    R1 := R1
    R2 := R2

if actionText == "SELL"
    S1 := S1
    S2 := S2
    R1 := radarResistance1
    R2 := radarResistance2

if actionText == "WAIT"
    S1 := radarSupport1
    S2 := na
    R1 := radarResistance1
    R2 := na

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== RADAR TREND ======================================================== //
// ========================================================================= //
string radarTrend = greenLine > redLine ? "UP" : "DOWN"
color radarTrendCol = greenLine > redLine ? color.rgb(0,180,0) : color.rgb(200,0,0)

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== VERTICAL TABLE (LONG FORMAT – NUMBERS ONLY) ======================== //
// ========================================================================= //
sigTablePos = sigTablePosInput == "bottom_right" ? position.bottom_right :sigTablePosInput == "bottom_left"  ? position.bottom_left  :sigTablePosInput == "top_right"    ? position.top_right    : position.top_left

var table verticalTable = table.new(sigTablePos, 2, 7, border_width=1, border_color=color.rgb(50,50,50))

if barstate.islast
    // العناوين
    table.cell(verticalTable, 0, 0, "Action", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(30,30,30), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 0, 1, "Support 1", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(30,30,30), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 0, 2, "Support 2", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(30,30,30), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 0, 3, "Resistance 1", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(30,30,30), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 0, 4, "Resistance 2", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(30,30,30), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 0, 5, "Radar Trend", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(30,30,30), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 0, 6, "Acceleration %", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(30,30,30), text_size=font_size)

    // القيم
    string trendArrow = actionText == "BUY" ? "↑" : actionText == "SELL" ? "↓" : "-"

    table.cell(verticalTable, 1, 0, actionText + " " + trendArrow, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=actionBg, text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 1, 1, str.tostring(S1, format.mintick), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(0,60,0), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 1, 2, str.tostring(S2, format.mintick), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(0,40,0), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 1, 3, str.tostring(R1, format.mintick), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(60,0,0), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 1, 4, str.tostring(R2, format.mintick), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(40,0,0), text_size=font_size)
    table.cell(verticalTable, 1, 5, radarTrend, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=radarTrendCol, text_size=font_size)

    // نسبة التسارع
    float accelPercent = strength * 100
    table.cell(verticalTable, 1, 6, str.tostring(accelPercent, "#.##") + "%", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.rgb(0,0,0), text_size=font_size)

// ========================================================================= //
// ==== ALERT CONDITIONS WITH ICONS ======================================== //
// ========================================================================= //

// 1) تنبيه إشارة BUY
alertcondition(
     barstate.isconfirmed and actionText == "BUY",
     title = "🚀🟢 BUY Signal",
     message = "🚀🟢 BUY Signal Detected on {{ticker}} at {{interval}}"
)

alertcondition(
     barstate.isconfirmed and actionText == "SELL",
     title = "🔻🔴 SELL Signal",
     message = "🔻🔴 SELL Signal Detected on {{ticker}} at {{interval}}"
)

bool breakSupport = close < S1
alertcondition(
     barstate.isconfirmed and breakSupport,
     title = "⚠️📉 Support Break",
     message = "⚠️📉 Price Broke Support Level on {{ticker}} at {{interval}}"
)

bool breakResistance = close > R1
alertcondition(
     barstate.isconfirmed and breakResistance,
     title = "⚠️📈 Resistance Break",
     message = "⚠️📈 Price Broke Resistance Level on {{ticker}} at {{interval}}"
)

bool hitUpTarget = false
for i = 0 to upTargets.size() - 1
    if high >= upTargets.get(i)
        hitUpTarget := true

alertcondition(
     barstate.isconfirmed and hitUpTarget,
     title = "🎯📈 Upper Target Hit",
     message = "🎯📈 Upper Target Hit on {{ticker}} at {{interval}}"
)

bool hitDownTarget = false
for i = 0 to downTargets.size() - 1
    if low <= downTargets.get(i)
        hitDownTarget := true

alertcondition(
     barstate.isconfirmed and hitDownTarget,
     title = "🎯📉 Lower Target Hit",
     message = "🎯📉 Lower Target Hit on {{ticker}} at {{interval}}"
)
